blurb.zh: 世界上最大的鱼，灰蓝背上布满白点。滤食浮游生物，常在近水面慢游，对人无害。
blurb.en: The world's largest fish, blue-grey with white spots. A harmless plankton feeder, often cruising slowly near the surface.

blurb.zh: 菱形大“翅膀”，头前有两片卷起的头鳍。常在礁区清洁站盘旋，静候即可，不要追赶。
blurb.en: A diamond-shaped ray with wide wings and two rolled head fins. Often circles reef cleaning stations; wait quietly, never chase.

blurb.zh: 白色肩斑呈 T 字形，嘴部发黑。多见于远海岛屿和海山，有时主动靠近潜水员。
blurb.en: Black back with T-shaped white shoulder patches and a dark mouth. Found around offshore islands and seamounts, sometimes approaching divers.

blurb.zh: 锤形头部前缘中央有凹口，两眼长在锤头两端。常在远海海山成群巡游，怕气泡。
blurb.en: A hammer-shaped head, notched at the centre, with eyes at the tips. Schools around offshore seamounts; shy of bubbles.

blurb.zh: 尾鳍上叶几乎和身体一样长，眼睛很大。常在清晨到浅滩清洁站，多在黎明下水等候。
blurb.en: An upper tail lobe almost as long as its body, and huge eyes. Visits shallow cleaning stations at dawn, so dives start early.

blurb.zh: 灰背白腹，尾鳍后缘有一道宽黑边。常在外礁墙和水道口迎流巡游，弓背是警告。
blurb.en: Grey with a broad black rear edge on the tail. Patrols outer walls and channels in current; a hunched back is a warning.

blurb.zh: 身材细长，背鳍和尾鳍上叶尖端雪白。白天常趴在沙底或礁洞里休息，性情温和。
blurb.en: Slender, with bright white tips on the dorsal fin and upper tail. Often rests on sand or in caves by day; calm.

blurb.zh: 吻部宽钝近方形，体侧有深色竖纹。多在向导带领的鲨鱼潜水中见到，须遵守简报。
blurb.en: A broad, square snout and dark vertical bars on the flanks. Mostly seen on guided shark dives; follow the briefing.

blurb.zh: 粗壮的灰色鲨鱼，没有明显斑纹，和其他灰鲨不易区分。多见于远洋海岛，常成群出现。
blurb.en: A stout, plain grey shark that is hard to tell from other grey sharks. Lives around remote oceanic islands, often in curious groups.

blurb.zh: 深色背上布满白点，吻部像鸭嘴，尾巴细长如鞭。常沿礁缘滑翔，有时成群，较害羞。
blurb.en: A dark back covered in white spots, a duck-bill snout and a whip-like tail. Glides along reef edges, sometimes in groups; shy.

blurb.zh: 小圆脑袋、短钝的喙，龟壳光滑。常在海草床进食或趴在礁上休息，不要触摸追赶。
blurb.en: A small rounded head, a short blunt beak and a smooth shell. Grazes in seagrass beds or rests on reefs; never touch or chase.

blurb.zh: 嘴尖带钩像鹰嘴，龟壳甲片像屋瓦层层叠盖。常在珊瑚礁缝里啃食海绵，属极危物种。
blurb.en: A hooked, hawk-like beak and overlapping shell plates like roof tiles. Feeds on sponges in reef crevices; critically endangered.

blurb.zh: 胸鳍极长、多带白色，头上布满疙瘩。冬季到暖水海域繁殖，通常只能跟持牌向导浮潜。
blurb.en: Very long, often white flippers and a knobbly head. Breeds in warm waters in winter; swims are usually snorkel-only with licensed guides.

blurb.zh: 方块状的大头约占身长三分之一，皮肤多皱。会深潜捕食乌贼，多从船上观看。
blurb.en: A huge square head about a third of its body, and wrinkled skin. Dives deep for squid; usually watched from boats.

blurb.zh: 黑白分明，眼后有白斑，雄性背鳍高直。挪威北部冬季常追鲱鱼进峡湾，可穿干衣浮潜。
blurb.en: Black and white with a white eye patch; males have a tall dorsal fin. Follows herring into northern Norway's fjords in winter, watched by snorkellers.

blurb.zh: 流线型灰色身体，有短喙和弯钩状背鳍。常跟船乘浪，水下相遇多半短暂，不要追赶。
blurb.en: A streamlined grey body with a short beak and curved dorsal fin. Often rides boat bow waves; underwater meetings are brief, so never chase.

blurb.zh: 圆胖的灰色身体，吻部宽大下弯，尾巴分叉。在浅水海草床吃草，胆小稀少，多为偶见。
blurb.en: A plump grey body, a broad downturned snout and a fluked tail. Grazes in shallow seagrass beds; shy and scarce, seen only occasionally.

blurb.zh: 有小外耳廓，靠长长的前鳍划水，脸像狗。幼崽好奇爱玩，常绕着潜水员转、咬脚蹼。
blurb.en: Small ear flaps, long front flippers for swimming and a dog-like face. Young ones are playful, circling divers and nibbling fins.

blurb.zh: 身体侧扁像圆盘，上下各有一片高鳍，没有真正的尾鳍。冷水上涌时会上到礁坡清洁站。
blurb.en: A tall, flat, disc-like body with one high fin above and one below. Rises to reef cleaning stations during cold upwellings, so it is seasonal.

blurb.zh: 成百上千条细长银亮的梭鱼聚成缓慢旋转的鱼柱。多在有流的岬角和峭壁外出现。
blurb.en: Hundreds of long, silver, sharp-jawed barracuda turning slowly in a column. Usually found off points and walls in current.

blurb.zh: 成百上千条银色大眼鲹聚成缓慢旋转的旋涡。常在有流的礁坡和海山外侧盘旋。
blurb.en: Hundreds of silver, big-eyed trevally circling in a slow vortex. Usually hangs off current-swept reef slopes and seamounts.

blurb.zh: 上百万条银色小鱼聚成不断变形的鱼团。南非 6–7 月常见；菲律宾墨宝全年都有。
blurb.en: Millions of small silver fish swirling in a shifting cloud. Off South Africa in June–July, and all year at Moalboal in the Philippines.

blurb.zh: 额头隆起大包，嘴前露出鸟喙般的板状牙。常成群啃食珊瑚，清晨较易遇到。
blurb.en: A bulging forehead and beak-like teeth. Roams the reef in herds, crunching coral; easiest to meet at dawn.

blurb.zh: 额头高高隆起、嘴唇厚，青绿色身上布满迷宫状细纹。好奇心强，常游近潜水员。
blurb.en: A big forehead hump, thick lips and a blue-green body with maze-like lines. Curious and often swims up to divers.

blurb.zh: 身上长满圆疙瘩，颜色和寄居的柳珊瑚一样。要靠向导指点才找得到，拍照少用闪光。
blurb.en: Covered in knobs that match the colour of its sea-fan host. You need a guide to find one; go easy on the flash.

blurb.zh: 没有壳的海洋软体动物，头上有一对触角，颜色鲜艳。种类上千，是微距摄影的常客。
blurb.en: Shell-less, often brightly coloured sea slugs with two sensory horns. Thousands of species crawl over reefs; a macro favourite.

blurb.zh: 身披橙蓝交织的漩涡花纹。白天躲在珊瑚碎块里，黄昏出来求偶，适合日落潜水观察。
blurb.en: Swirling orange and electric-blue patterns. Hides in coral rubble by day and comes out at dusk to mate, so look for it on sunset dives.

blurb.zh: 尾巴约占全身一半，黄褐色身上布满深色斑点。白天常趴在沙底休息，性情温和。
blurb.en: A very long tail and dark spots on tan skin; juveniles are striped. Usually rests on sand by day and is calm.

blurb.zh: 身体圆胖、皮肤粗糙，头顶有钓竿状诱饵。常伪装成海绵、几天不动，多靠向导指认。
blurb.en: Round and lumpy, with a fishing lure on its head. Mimics sponges and may sit still for days; guides know where to look.

blurb.zh: 背鳍和胸鳍又大又圆，末端带斑驳白色。生活在外海，常在近水面好奇地靠近人。
blurb.en: Huge rounded dorsal and pectoral fins with mottled white tips. An open-ocean shark, bold and curious near the surface.

blurb.zh: 灰白色身体上布满土豆状的深色大斑块。常守着固定礁区，会游到潜水员面镜前。
blurb.en: A big grouper with dark potato-shaped blotches on a pale body. Holds a home patch of reef and often swims right up to divers.

blurb.zh: 吻部尖窄的须鲸，肩部有白斑。6–7 月常见于大堡礁北部，会好奇地靠近浮潜者。
blurb.en: A sleek baleen whale with a pointed snout and pale shoulder patches. Visits the northern Great Barrier Reef in June–July, often approaching snorkellers.

blurb.zh: 珊瑚礁里最大的石斑，大嘴厚唇、灰褐斑驳。常在沉船和码头桩柱间缓慢悬停。
blurb.en: The largest reef grouper, with a huge thick-lipped mouth and mottled grey-brown skin. Often hangs slowly around wrecks and jetty pilings.

blurb.zh: 满嘴参差外露的尖牙，看着凶，其实温和。常在岩沟或沉船旁几乎静止地悬停。
blurb.en: Ragged teeth jut from its mouth, yet it is placid. Often hovers almost motionless in rocky gutters or beside wrecks.

blurb.zh: 鱼雷形身体、圆锥形吻部，灰背白腹分界清晰。通常在防鲨笼里观看。
blurb.en: A torpedo-shaped body, conical snout and sharp line between grey back and white belly. Usually viewed from shark cages.

blurb.zh: 近圆形的宽体盘，尾巴短粗带毒刺。夏季在新西兰穷骑士群岛的岩拱下常成群聚集。
blurb.en: An almost round grey disc with a short tail carrying a venomous spine. Gathers under rock arches at New Zealand's Poor Knights in summer.

blurb.zh: 菱形扁平体盘，尾巴长如鞭、带毒刺。常埋在沙里只露眼睛，加勒比海浅沙地常见。
blurb.en: A flat diamond-shaped disc with a long whip tail and venomous spine. Often lies buried in sand on Caribbean flats, eyes showing.

blurb.zh: 灰褐色背、白腹，没有明显斑纹。加勒比海最常见的礁鲨，常在礁墙外侧巡游。
blurb.en: Grey-brown above and white below, with no bold markings. The commonest reef shark in the Caribbean, often patrolling outer walls.

blurb.zh: 身形细长、皮肤光滑，胸鳍又长又窄。生活在外海，常成群在近水面绕船打转。
blurb.en: Slim and smooth-skinned, with very long, narrow pectoral fins. An open-ocean shark that often circles boats near the surface in groups.

blurb.zh: 体色黄褐，两个背鳍几乎一样大。常在浅沙地、潟湖和红树林活动，喂鲨潜水中也常见。
blurb.en: A yellowish-brown shark with two dorsal fins of nearly equal size. Favours sand flats, lagoons and mangroves; regular on shark-feed dives.

blurb.zh: 体形粗壮，吻部短而钝圆，通体灰色。能进河口和淡水，多在有向导的鲨鱼潜水中见到。
blurb.en: Very thick-bodied, with a short, blunt snout and plain grey colouring. Can enter rivers; usually seen on guided shark dives.

blurb.zh: 头宽扁，小嘴旁有两根短须，体色黄褐。白天常趴在沙底或岩下休息，被骚扰会咬人。
blurb.en: A broad flat head, two short barbels by the mouth and a tan body. Rests on sand or under ledges by day; bites if harassed.

blurb.zh: 吻部细长，背上有成排骨质鳞甲，尾巴有力。栖息在红树林，下水观看通常跟向导浮潜。
blurb.en: A long narrow snout, bony plates along the back and a powerful tail. Lives in mangroves; viewing is usually a guided snorkel at a distance.

blurb.zh: 造礁的主角，有鹿角状、桌状、脑状等形态。生长缓慢、一碰就断，要控制好浮力。
blurb.en: The reef builders, in branching, table and brain shapes. They grow slowly and break easily, so keep good buoyancy.

blurb.zh: 没有硬骨骼，像一丛丛半透明的彩色小树。有水流时膨胀张开，在有流的礁墙最茂盛。
blurb.en: Corals without a stony skeleton, like small translucent trees in pink, red and orange. They open up in current, thriving on current-swept walls.

blurb.zh: 修长的须鲸，头顶有三条平行纵脊。广西涠洲岛附近冬春可乘船观看。
blurb.en: A slender baleen whale with three parallel ridges on top of the head. Watched from boats off China's Weizhou Island in winter and spring.

blurb.zh: 背鳍和尾鳍尖端漆黑。常在潟湖和礁坪浅水活动，站在岸边常能看到露出水面的背鳍。
blurb.en: Crisp black tips on the dorsal fin and tail. Patrols shallow lagoons and reef flats, its fin often visible from the beach.

blurb.zh: 胸鳍末端弯成镰刀状，背部橄榄褐色。夏季常在亚速尔群岛的外海浅滩成群出现。
blurb.en: Sickle-shaped wingtips and an olive-brown back. In summer it gathers in groups over offshore banks in the Azores.

blurb.zh: 深褐色身上有不规则的浅黄斑块，头大嘴阔。在地中海保护区里常大方地游近潜水员。
blurb.en: Dark brown with irregular pale blotches and a big mouth. Bold inside Mediterranean marine reserves, where it often approaches divers.

blurb.zh: 形似鲑鱼，背部橄榄绿，繁殖期腹部变橙红。冰岛丝浮拉裂缝的淡水里偶见。
blurb.en: A salmon-like fish with an olive back; breeding fish turn orange-red below. Occasionally seen in Iceland's freshwater Silfra fissure.

blurb.zh: 身体圆滚，没有外耳廓，前鳍短小。多见于冷水海域，年轻个体好奇，常凑近潜水员。
blurb.en: A plump body, no external ear flaps and short front flippers. Mostly in cold seas; young seals are curious and approach divers.

blurb.zh: 成千上万条半透明的金色小鱼，挤满礁洞和沉船舱，潜水员经过时像帘子般分开。
blurb.en: Thousands of small, translucent golden fish packed into caves and wreck holds, parting like a curtain as divers pass.

blurb.zh: 金褐色的巨藻从岩底长到水面，阳光从缝隙洒下。生长在冷水海岸，留意别被缠住。
blurb.en: Golden-brown kelp rising from the rocks to the surface, with sunlight slanting through. Grows on cold coasts; watch for entanglement.

blurb.zh: 成鱼灰黑色带隐约斑点，幼鱼却是橙红色。夏季常聚到南加州巨藻林边缘产卵。
blurb.en: Adults are dark grey with faint spots; juveniles are orange-red. Gathers at the edges of southern California's kelp forests in summer to spawn.

blurb.zh: 身体细长，背上有一道道深色鞍斑。夏秋常聚在圣地亚哥拉霍亚的浅水，浮潜可见。
blurb.en: A slim grey shark with dark saddle bars across its back. Gathers in the shallows at La Jolla, San Diego, in summer and autumn; snorkel-friendly.

blurb.zh: 上颌延长如长矛，体侧有钴蓝色竖纹。墨西哥下加州 10–11 月常冲进沙丁鱼群。
blurb.en: A long spear-like bill and cobalt-blue stripes on the flanks. Off Baja California in October–November it slashes through sardine bait balls.

blurb.zh: 地球上最大的动物，蓝灰色带斑驳。斯里兰卡南岸 11–4 月可乘船观看，不下水。
blurb.en: The largest animal on Earth, mottled blue-grey. Watched from boats, not in the water, off southern Sri Lanka from November to April.

blurb.zh: 细长身体带小叶状突起，红橙底色点缀黄斑。只见于澳大利亚南部，常在浅水海藻旁漂游。
blurb.en: A slender, red-orange body with yellow spots and small leafy tabs. Found only in southern Australia, drifting by shallow kelp and seagrass.

blurb.zh: 腿细长，背甲多刺、常沾满藻类。入冬前后常有上万只聚到墨尔本栈桥浅水蜕壳。
blurb.en: Long spindly legs and a spiny, algae-covered shell. Around early winter, thousands mass under Melbourne's piers to moult together.

blurb.zh: 黑与蓝灰相间的环纹，尾巴扁平像船桨。毒性强但性情温和，保持距离、不要触碰。
blurb.en: Banded in black and blue-grey, with a paddle-like tail. Highly venomous but usually docile; keep your distance and never touch.

blurb.zh: 细长的小鲨鱼，胸鳍后有像肩章的黑斑。会用鳍在礁上“走路”，夜潜时最易见到。
blurb.en: A small spotted shark with a dark epaulette patch behind its fins. Walks over the reef on its fins; easiest to find on night dives.

blurb.zh: 锤头前缘几乎平直，背鳍高耸如镰刀。巴哈马比米尼 12–3 月常到近岸浅沙地。
blurb.en: A nearly straight-edged hammer and a very tall, sickle-shaped dorsal fin. Visits shallow sand at Bimini, Bahamas, from December to March.

blurb.zh: 黄褐色的大石斑，头宽扁、眼睛小。7–9 月常成群聚在佛罗里达沉船上产卵。
blurb.en: A massive yellowish-brown grouper with a broad flat head and small eyes. Gathers on Florida wrecks to spawn in July–September.

blurb.zh: 头像马、嘴呈细管状，尾巴能卷住海草。常伪装在浅水海草或杂物旁，多靠向导发现。
blurb.en: A horse-like head, a tube snout and a gripping tail. Well camouflaged in shallow seagrass or on silty bottoms; guides help spot them.

blurb.zh: 橙黄到黑褐色，身上有两三道白色横带，住在海葵里。护家心强，会冲出来啄潜水员。
blurb.en: Orange to dark brown with two or three white bands, living in a sea anemone. Defends its home boldly and may nip at divers.

blurb.zh: 褐底白点的小河豚。雄鱼在沙底筑出几何圆圈求偶，日本奄美大岛春夏可见。
blurb.en: A brown pufferfish with white spots. Males sculpt circular patterns in the sand to court females; found off Amami Oshima, Japan, in spring–summer.

blurb.zh: 身体透明、无壳，靠一对翅膀状小鳍游动。北海道知床 2–3 月的流冰下可见。
blurb.en: A transparent, shell-less drifter that flaps a pair of wing-like fins. Seen under the drift ice off Shiretoko, Hokkaido, in February–March.

blurb.zh: 活着时像一丛白色小树，“黑”指它的骨骼。新西兰峡湾约 10 米深就能见到。
blurb.en: Alive it looks like a white bushy tree; 'black' is its skeleton. In New Zealand's fiords it grows as shallow as about 10 m.

blurb.zh: 小花般的个体，触手末端是圆球，粉紫橙红各色成片铺满岩壁。新西兰北部常见。
blurb.en: Tiny flower-like polyps with knob-tipped tentacles, carpeting rock in patches of pink, purple, orange and red. Common in northern New Zealand.

blurb.zh: 全身长满海藻叶般的突起，黄褐带绿。只分布在澳大利亚南部，常藏在浅水海藻间。
blurb.en: Covered in leafy, seaweed-like flaps in yellow-brown and green. Lives only in southern Australia, hiding among shallow kelp; hard to spot.

blurb.zh: 能瞬间变换体色和纹理，身体一圈有波浪鳍。5–8 月常在南澳怀阿拉浅水聚集繁殖。
blurb.en: Changes colour and texture in an instant, with a frilly fin around its body. Masses to breed in the shallows near Whyalla, South Australia, May–August.

blurb.zh: 没有背鳍，通体黑色，头上有白色老茧。阿根廷瓦尔德斯半岛 6–12 月可乘船观看。
blurb.en: No dorsal fin, a black body and rough white patches on the head. Watched from boats off Península Valdés, Argentina, from June to December.

blurb.zh: 金黄色的淡水掠食鱼，尾鳍橙红带黑纹。巴西博尼图的清水河里常见，多为浮潜观看。
blurb.en: A golden freshwater predator with an orange-red, black-striped tail. Common in the clear rivers of Bonito, Brazil, usually seen while snorkelling.

blurb.zh: 每侧七道鳃裂，只有一个靠后的背鳍，身上散布小黑点。开普敦福尔斯湾海带林里常见。
blurb.en: Seven gill slits a side, a single dorsal fin far back and small dark spots. Common in the kelp forests of False Bay, Cape Town.

blurb.zh: 脑袋特别大、颌部粗壮，龟壳红褐。希腊扎金索斯岛 5–8 月上岸产卵，湾内常见。
blurb.en: A big head with powerful jaws and a reddish-brown shell. Nests on Greece's Zakynthos in May–August and is often seen in the bay.

blurb.zh: 进食时张开山洞般的大嘴，鳃裂几乎绕头一圈。滤食浮游生物，苏格兰夏季可浮潜观看。
blurb.en: Feeds with a cavernous mouth wide open; its gill slits nearly circle the head. A harmless plankton feeder, met by snorkellers off Scotland in summer.

blurb.zh: 灰色圆胖、嘴边长满胡须，尾巴呈圆桨形。冬季聚到佛罗里达泉水湾避寒，只能浮潜静观。
blurb.en: Plump and grey, with a whiskery snout and a round paddle tail. Winters in Florida's spring-fed bays, where snorkellers may only watch quietly.

blurb.zh: 身体扁平像魟鱼，胸鳍宽如翅膀，常埋在沙里只露轮廓。如今主要见于加那利群岛。
blurb.en: Flat like a ray, with wing-like fins, it lies buried in sand with only its outline showing. Now seen mainly in the Canary Islands.

blurb.zh: 鲜红的小枝状珊瑚伸出白色珊瑚虫，常倒挂在地中海洞穴顶部。生长极慢，勿触碰。
blurb.en: Small bright-red branches with white polyps, often hanging from the ceilings of Mediterranean caves. Grows very slowly; never touch.

blurb.zh: 扇形的大柳珊瑚，枝条紫红、有的末端带黄。在地中海有流的岩壁上密集成林。
blurb.en: Large fan-shaped gorgonians, purple-red and sometimes yellow-tipped. Forms dense forests on current-swept Mediterranean walls.

blurb.zh: 形似鳗鱼，其实是狼鱼；头大颌壮，身上有深色圆斑。常成对住在岩洞里，卑诗省常见。
blurb.en: Eel-shaped but actually a wolffish, with a big head, strong jaws and dark spots. Pairs often share a rocky den in British Columbia.

blurb.zh: 世界上最大的章鱼，皮肤红褐、能迅速变色。白天躲在岩洞里，洞口常堆着蟹壳。
blurb.en: The largest octopus, reddish-brown and quick to change colour. Hides in rocky dens by day, often marked by piles of crab shells.

blurb.zh: 两根长象牙、满脸硬须，身体肥厚。北极斯瓦尔巴群岛夏季探险船偶有机会在附近下水。
blurb.en: Long ivory tusks, a bristly moustache and a massive wrinkled body. Summer expedition ships around Svalbard occasionally let divers in nearby.

blurb.zh: 头大而钝，露出犬牙般的獠牙，身上有深色竖纹。常躲在岩缝里只露出头，白海冰潜可见。
blurb.en: A big blunt head with fang-like teeth and dark vertical bars. Peers out of rocky crevices; seen on White Sea ice dives in Russia.

blurb.zh: 下巴有一根短须，背上三个背鳍，橄榄褐色带斑点。冰岛热泉烟囱旁常成群绕游。
blurb.en: A chin barbel, three dorsal fins and a mottled olive-brown body. Often circles the hydrothermal chimneys of Strýtan, Iceland.

blurb.zh: 不会飞的海鸟，背黑腹白，在水下“飞”得很快。多分布在南半球冷水海域，常一闪而过。
blurb.en: Flightless black-and-white seabirds that 'fly' fast underwater. Found mostly in cold southern seas; divers usually glimpse them darting past.
